//: F83 (proposal § 11). Gzip bytes. Wave 0 measured on the publishable build (the keys of the .env): main script 301,830 B, react-vendor 68,691 B, the canary 1,986 B (reports/evidence/F83/wave-0/). `main` was the ceiling of wave 0 (the proposal's 316,000 B); from wave 1 it is the value measured on the integration branch before the wave, on the publishable build (302,542 B: integrate/staging-2026-11-21 at a912eaf, where wave 1 began, 712 B above wave 0's own 301,830 B because `main` was merged in between): it only goes down. Wave 1 measured 302,424 B (reports/evidence/F83/wave-1/bundle-budget-wave-1.txt). Wave 2 (the playlists screen, 2.600 hand-made lines out of the main script) measured 290,606 B without the keys against 302,292 B before it (reports/evidence/F83/wave-2/bundle-budget-wave-2.txt): the ceiling came down to 290,750 B (the 11,686 B the main script shrank, plus 144 B for the keys of the publishable build, which wave 1 measured at 132 B above the build without them). Wave 3 (the shell of the site in React: top bar, footer, shell of the phone, sign-in window, 1.402 hand-made lines out of the main script and React components in) measured 294,753 B without the keys against 290,606 B after wave 2 (reports/evidence/F83/wave-3/bundle-budget-wave-3.txt): the main script GREW by 4,147 B (the shell is now code of the main script, and the React version of a piece weighs more than its HTML string), and the ceiling went up to 294,897 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). From wave 3 `reactAtStart` is true: the main script imports react-vendor (68,691 B) and app.html preloads it, so the first screen downloads 363,444 B instead of 290,606 B (+72,838 B) and every later screen in React is only its own file. Wave 4 (the Start screen, the first screen, 1.054 hand-made lines out of the main script and a lazy file of 12,176 B in; the file starts to come down with the login) measured 285,730 B without the keys against 294,773 B after wave 3 (reports/evidence/F83/wave-4/bundle-budget-wave-4.txt): the main script shrank 9,043 B and the ceiling came down to 285,874 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). Wave 5a (the albums screen: the series view, the controller of the session, the cards, the pagers, the filter bar and ≈ 3.4 thousand hand-made lines out of the main script, a lazy file of 19,997 B and the filter bar file of 2,619 B in) measured 230,315 B without the keys against 285,730 B after wave 4 (reports/evidence/F83/wave-5a/bundle-budget-wave-5a.txt): the main script shrank 55,415 B and the ceiling came down to 230,459 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). Wave 5b (the windows of the albums screen: the series edit with its album picker, the delete question and the ranking window, 1.073 hand-made lines out of lazy files, React files in the albums screen file, 19,997 B to 23,565 B, and the picker's controller as a lazy file of 6,332 B that the Start screen and the windows share) measured 231,568 B without the keys against 230,315 B after wave 5a (reports/evidence/F83/wave-5b/bundle-budget-wave-5b.txt): the main script GREW by 1,253 B, and only for one reason: the English texts of the three windows (102 keys of the dictionary, 5,925 characters; English is always in the main script, the Portuguese file is lazy). The ceiling went up to 231,712 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). What the first screen and the screens after it download did not grow: React and the screens after the first one went from 181,764 B to 180,603 B. Sync of main (the menu of F88 in React: the bar of five stops over the row of bars, the account panel with the connections of Apple Music and Spotify, the phone's bottom menu and Menu sheet; the old menu's pieces, the series dropdown, the drawer and the Spotify button, out) measured 233,446 B without the keys against 231,568 B after wave 5b (reports/evidence/F83/sync-main/bundle-budget-sync-main.txt): the main script GREW by 1,878 B, for three reasons: the new menu is more code than the one it replaces (the connections model and its rows, the account panel with its keyboard rules, the bar with its fitting and its stop icons), the 25 English texts of the menu in the dictionary (English is always in the main script), and the home's bar function (splash/menu.js, shared with the entry page) now reached from the app, which the build made a small file of its own (menu-*.js, 2,595 B) that the first screen also downloads. The ceiling went up to 233,590 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys); `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B). `background` is the allowance for what comes after the first screen besides React: the 28,198 B the lazy pieces of today already weigh (SavedPlaylistsView, SpotifyExportModal, crate3d... measured on main@3356113) plus the 20,000 B the proposal gives to new screens and to the Portuguese dictionary. Second sync of main (the inventory's gallery on the phone, the Discogs values kept in the database and the home's opening in Portuguese, all in hand-made code that stays hand-made; the F90 export window written in React) measured 235,695 B without the keys against 233,446 B after the first sync (reports/evidence/F83/sync-2/bundle-budget-sync-2.txt): the main script GREW by 2,249 B, 1,997 B of them from the merge alone (235,443 B at 53ef3a6: the inventory code of F89 and F75 and the home's text, in the main script because the inventory is still hand-made) and 252 B from the port (the 25 English texts of the export window and the saved playlists, which English keeps in the main script; the window and its folder step are a lazy file of 6,426 B, PlaylistExportWindow-*.js, that the playlists and the saved playlists screens download when «Export» is pressed). The ceiling went up to 235,839 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). What comes after the first screen grew from 182,264 B to 186,719 B (the merge 415 B, the window 4,040 B, the rest the inventory's lazy code), so `background` went from 48,198 B to 49,000 B: the sum of the main script and what comes after (422,414 B) is inside main-of-today + React + background (422,437 B). `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B). Third sync of main (the lean Start on the phone, F79 / UAT-281, ported to the Start screen in React: the «What is a series?» sheet, the one link under the field, the bar only with the first cover, the notice only with an album, 4 English texts) measured 235,748 B without the keys against 235,695 B before it (reports/evidence/F83/sync-3/bundle-budget-sync-3.txt): the main script GREW by 53 B (the 4 English texts, which English keeps in the main script) and what comes after the first screen by 417 B (the Start screen's lazy file, 12,186 B to 12,577 B, and the dictionary of Portuguese), which put the sum of the two 447 B over main-of-today + React + `background` (422,884 B against 422,437 B). The ceiling of the main script went up to 235,892 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys) and `background` from 49,000 B to 49,500 B (the measured need is 49,447 B). `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B). Wave 6a (the inventory screen: the view, its renderers and sheets, the card, the trail, the controller's wiring of the screen and ≈ 2.1 thousand hand-made lines out of the main script, a lazy file of 21,503 B in, with the controller and InventoryValues, the models they use, and the 129 English texts of the dictionary; the inventory is still read at sign-in because app.js imports services/inventory/inventoryWiring.js itself) measured 211,698 B without the keys against 235,748 B after the third sync (reports/evidence/F83/wave-6a/bundle-budget-wave-6a.txt): the main script shrank 24,050 B and the ceiling came down to 211,842 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). The screen's file (21,503 B) is under the 30,000 B alarm of a screen, so the phone's sheets stay in it (no split was needed). What comes after the first screen grew from 187,136 B to 212,976 B (+25,840 B: the screen's file, the buy links, the tracks sorting that the albums screen and the inventory screen now share as a file, and the Portuguese dictionary), which put the sum of the two 1,737 B over main-of-today + React + `background` (424,674 B against 422,937 B). `background` went from 49,500 B to 51,300 B (the measured need is 51,237 B). `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B). Wave 6b (the windows of the albums and inventory screens: the album window with its value section, the table and the comparison of the tracks, the window to edit an item and the one to add an album; 1.698 hand-made lines out of lazy files, React files in: the album window and its comparison are a lazy file of their own, openAlbumWindow-*.js, that both screens download when a card is pressed, the inventory's two windows and the value section a lazy file, inventoryWindows-*.js, and the table of the tracks is part of the albums screen's file, which already held it behind a wrapper) measured 213,079 B without the keys against 211,698 B after wave 6a (reports/evidence/F83/wave-6b/bundle-budget-wave-6b.txt): the main script GREW by 1,381 B, and only for one reason: the English texts of the windows (≈ 120 keys of the dictionary; English is always in the main script, the Portuguese file is lazy). The ceiling went up to 213,223 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). What comes after the first screen grew from 212,976 B to 213,896 B; the sum of the two is over main-of-today + React + `background` by the measured need, so `background` went from 51,300 B to 53,600 B. `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B), and the alarm of a screen (30,000 B) did not move: the biggest file after the main script is the albums screen's, 25,232 B. Wave 7a (the recipe cards and the ingredients in React in ui/recipe/, the panel to generate again of the playlists screen in React, its wrapper and its hand-made file out; the hand-made Blend screen still draws its own cards and ingredients, so the main script still holds them, and the English texts of the recipes, the ingredients and the panel, ≈ 95 keys, are in the main script) measured 213,922 B without the keys against 213,079 B after wave 6b (reports/evidence/F83/wave-7a/bundle-budget-wave-7a.txt): the main script GREW by 843 B, for one reason: the English texts (English is always in the main script, the Portuguese file is lazy; the removed panel file was small). The ceiling went up to 214,066 B (the measured value plus the 144 B of the keys). What comes after the first screen grew from 213,896 B to 215,799 B (+1,903 B: the playlists screen's file, 10,340 B to 12,216 B, holds the panel, the cards and the ingredients as React, and the Portuguese dictionary grew); the sum of the two is over main-of-today + React + `background` by the measured need, so `background` went from 53,600 B to 56,300 B (the measured need is 56,284 B). `reactVendor` did not change (68,691 B), and the alarm of a screen (30,000 B) did not move: the biggest file after the main script is still the albums screen's, 25,235 B. Wave 7b takes the hand-made pieces and the Blend screen out of the main script: the ceiling comes down then.
